scope: Proposition 4.9 (Codimension-two strip saving) of the manuscript “Endpoint pointwise convergence for the Schrodinger equation in higher dimensions” (preprints/Endpoint-pointwise-convergence-for-the-Schrodinger-equation-in-higher-dimensions-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 080 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 4f859efa28f227ff), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 52. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix 0 < α < 1/8. Suppose g has bounded frequency support contained in an O(S−α) neighborhood of an affine (n − 2)-plane, and Q is a collection of unit cubes in a ball of radius S with at most m0rn cubes in every radius-r ball, r ≥ 1. Fix any b with β < b < 2/n. There is c0 > 0, depending only on the fixed dimensional choices and independent of α, such that for every ε > 0, X q∈Q sup q |Eg|2 ≤ Cα,εmb 0Sn/(n+1)−c0α+ε ∥g∥2 2. (4.17) In particular, for m0 = So(1) this is the saving Sn/(n+1)−c0α+o(1). Finite disjoint subinputs are allowed, with their squared norms summed on the right.
